reading_order: Read the complete Gelbach article and appendices
Only then confronted the four bounded prior Gate 1 artifacts
key_conclusions: The exact finite-sample decomposition and the IVB scalar/vector identity are the same core object up to sign convention.
Gelbach directly supports population projection components already represented in the prior derivation; causal interpretation remains an additional assumption layer.
Appendix B already includes joint covariance terms, robust or group-cluster estimation, and a warning about degeneracy when both product factors are zero.
Cancellation within a block and across blocks is explicitly illustrated, so a small net shift hiding opposing components is not itself novel.
The B,C,U temporal trade is the team's construction from two nested Gelbach applications, not a single allocation literally stated by Gelbach.
Covariance between the B/U and C/U contrasts must be derived from a common estimating system or paired resampling; it is not a literal formula published for that trade in Gelbach 2016.
The frozen P and C+ remain equivalent in the declared OLS domain when given the same causal information.
The integral reading strengthened bibliographic attribution and did not add post-test capabilities to frozen C+; IV, Hausman, weights and instruments remain outside the unweighted-OLS test.

A TSCS timing/history protocol remains a possible operational contribution, but it is unproven and must acknowledge that Gelbach already requires a defensible full model and notes timing-based causal order.
